origin: Original fixed exercises written by the project authors; no real student data.

exercises.question: A batch of 240 exercise books contains 35% graph-paper books. How many graph-paper books are there?
In a sale a bookshop sells a book at 20% off for 72 dollars. What was the original price in dollars?
exercises.solution: 20% off keeps 0.8 of the original price, so 72 ÷ 0.8 = 90.

exercises.question: A club grows from 40 members to 50 members. What is the percent increase? Give the number before the percent sign.
exercises.solution: It grew by 10 members; with the original 40 as the base, 10 ÷ 40 × 100 = 25.

exercises.question: Sign-ups for an event fall from 125 people to 100 people. What is the percent decrease? Give the number before the percent sign.
exercises.solution: It fell by 25 people; with the original 125 as the base, 25 ÷ 125 × 100 = 20.

exercises.question: An item originally costs 200 dollars. Its price is first raised by 10% and then lowered by 10%. What is the final price in dollars?
exercises.solution: 200 × 1.1 × 0.9 = 198; the two percentages have different bases.

exercises.question: In a survey, the share of people in favor rises from 30% to 42%. By how many percentage points did it rise?

exercises.topic: Recovering the amount after a change
exercises.question: After 25% of the rice in a bag is taken out, 18 kilograms remain. How many kilograms were in the bag at first?

Class A has 30 students and 40% of them sing in the choir; Class B has 20 students and 25% of them sing in the choir. What percentage of the two classes together sings in the choir? Give the number before the percent sign.
exercises.solution: 12 + 5 = 17 students out of a whole of 50, so 17 ÷ 50 × 100 = 34.

exercises.question: A number is first decreased by 20%. By what percentage must the decreased number be increased to get back to the original number? Give the number before the percent sign.
exercises.solution: After the decrease it is 0.8 of the original, so it needs an increase of 0.2 ÷ 0.8 = 25%.

exercises.question: A glass of sugar water weighs 150 grams in total, and sugar makes up 12% of it. After 50 grams of water are added, what percentage of the total weight is sugar? Give the number before the percent sign.
exercises.solution: The 18 grams of sugar do not change and the total becomes 200 grams, so 18 ÷ 200 × 100 = 9.
